note.description: For example "You" on the caller's own row.

is_leader.description: Whether this member leads the group.

remove.description: Removes this member (swipe to remove, specs/COMMUNITY.md 5.2), sent only to people who may remove them: a destructive `call` with confirmation and `on_success` `refresh`.

toggle_leader.description: True when the caller may make this member a leader or remove their leadership, in edit mode.
